d: Ancient earthly room in the castle of the Baron, with five doors, on the right fireplace, coffee table with mirror, basket with flowers and chairs. Clorinda trying a skissé, Tisbe hairing a flower now to the forehead now to the chest; Cinderella blowing with a mantle to the fireplace to boil a cup of coffee; then Alidoro when poor; then Followers of Ramiro.
Don Magnificent bieco in face comes out in beretta from the night and dresses as a bedroom, and said, in Cinderella.
Don Ramiro.
Cinderella and said.
Ramiro solo, indi Don Magnifico in a gala dress without a hat.
Knights, Dandini, and sayings, then Clorinda and Tisbe.
After a few moments of silence Alidoro enters in a pilgrim's dress with the philosopher's clothes below; then Cinderella.
Cabinet in the casino of Don Ramiro. Dandini entering with Clorinda and Tisbe under the arm; Don Magnifico and Don Ramiro.
Dandini, Clorinda and Tisbe.

Delicious in the casino of Prince Don Ramiro. Magnificent Don to whom the Knights put a cloak colored ponsò with silver embroideries of grape bunches, and jump around beating his feet in time of music. Small tables with delivery to write.
Dandini and Don Ramiro running on the front of the stage, observing for every part.
Clorinda running one way, and Tisbe the other.
Knights' choir inside the scenes, indi Alidoro.
Knights who precede, and Schierani in double row to receive Cinderella, who in rich and elegant dress advance veiled.
Don Magnifico running, and sayings.
Cabinet in the palace of Don Ramiro. Knights, Don Magnifico, entering with Clorinda and Tisbe under the arm, and observing the Knights leaving.
Ramiro, then Cinderella fleeing from Dandini; then Alidoro in the background.
Dandini, Alidoro; and Don Magnifico.
Alidoro alone.
Earthly room with fireplace in the house of Don Magnifico. Cinderella in the usual dress next to the fire.
Don Magnifico, Clorinda, Tisbe and said.
Don Magnifico, Tisbe, Clorinda, and Ramiro as Prince and Dandini.
Cinderella bringing a noble chair to Dandini, who believes the prince.
Tisbe and Clorinda, Alidoro.

At the rising of the tent I saw an atrium with flowers festoons illuminated, and in the bottom of which on a small base sit in two rich chairs Ramiro and Cinderella in rich dress; on the right standing Dandini, Dame and Knights around. In a corner Don Magnifico, confused, with thick eyes on the ground. Indi Alidoro, Clorinda and Tisbe, mortified, covering his face.
